items.title: Google Digital Skills for Africa
items.summary: Free digital marketing and online business learning from Google.
items.bestFor: Beginners, jobseekers and small business owners
requirements: Google account may be needed for progress tracking and certificates.
items.watchOut: Check the course page before promising a certificate because course availability can change.

items.title: Microsoft Learn South Africa
items.summary: Free learning paths, product training and selected virtual training events from Microsoft.
items.bestFor: Students, IT beginners and people building technical skills
requirements: Microsoft account is useful for saving progress; some certifications or exams may cost money.
items.watchOut: Free learning content is not always the same as a free certification exam.

items.title: Vodacom Digital Skills Hub
items.summary: Free digital-skills courses, with some learning routes promoted as zero-rated for Vodacom users.
items.bestFor: Young people and jobseekers looking for digital skills
requirements: Registration is usually required; data benefits may depend on network and current programme rules.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current course catalogue and any zero-rated data wording on Vodacom's own page.

items.title: Book Dash
items.summary: Free African children's picture books that can be read, downloaded, printed and shared under an open model.
items.bestFor: Parents, teachers, libraries and reading clubs
requirements: No purchase needed for digital books; printing or data may still have normal user costs.
items.watchOut: Use the official Book Dash library rather than third-party download mirrors.

items.title: Nal'ibali
items.summary: Free stories, audio stories, printables and reading resources in South African languages.
items.bestFor: Families, teachers and caregivers of children aged 0-12
requirements: No purchase needed for online resources; downloads and printing may use data or paper.
items.watchOut: Choose the language and age level that fits the child instead of downloading random PDFs.

items.title: FunDza
items.summary: Mobile-friendly South African stories, reading content and literacy resources.
items.bestFor: Teens, young adults and mobile readers
requirements: Works best online or on mobile; account features may vary by current platform setup.
items.watchOut: It is stronger for teen and young-adult reading than preschool picture books.

items.title: Experian South Africa
items.summary: Free access to Experian personal credit report and credit score through Experian's consumer platform.
items.bestFor: Consumers checking their credit report and score
requirements: Valid South African ID details and identity verification are expected.
items.watchOut: Use Experian's official site and never share banking passwords or card PINs.

items.title: TransUnion South Africa
items.summary: Free annual credit report access from TransUnion South Africa.
items.bestFor: Consumers using their free annual bureau report right
requirements: Identity verification is required before report access.
items.watchOut: A free credit report is not the same as guaranteed credit approval.

items.title: ClearScore South Africa
items.summary: Free credit score and report access, with personalised financial offers shown separately.
items.bestFor: Consumers who want ongoing score and report visibility
requirements: Sign-up and identity checks are required.
items.watchOut: Treat loan and credit offers as advertising or eligibility guidance, not approval.

items.title: Brand Advisor
items.summary: Product exchange and trial opportunities may be available when campaigns are open.
items.bestFor: Consumers interested in product testing and honest feedback
requirements: Application, profile details and content or feedback may be required.
items.watchOut: Campaigns are limited and not every application gets selected.

items.title: National Consumer Commission complaints portal
items.summary: Official National Consumer Commission information and complaint route for eligible consumer complaints.
items.bestFor: Consumers who need an official complaint route under the Consumer Protection Act
requirements: A registered e-Services profile, complaint details and supporting proof may be required.
items.watchOut: This is not a giveaway. Use it for consumer-rights support and keep copies of complaint references and evidence.

items.title: Free basic municipal services
items.summary: Government guidance on free basic water, electricity, sanitation or other municipal support for qualifying households.
items.bestFor: Low-income households checking whether they qualify for municipal indigent support
requirements: Usually means-tested through the local municipality; extra usage can still be billed.
items.watchOut: Rules differ by municipality, so confirm eligibility, documents and limits with your own local municipality.

items.title: Spur R50 birthday voucher
items.summary: A registered member who spent at least R1,000 at Spur in the 12 months before their birthday receives a R50 birthday voucher in their profile on the birthday.
items.bestFor: Registered Spur Family members who already spend regularly at Spur
requirements: Register a Spur Family profile in the app and reach R1,000 cumulative qualifying Spur spend during the 12 months before the birthday.
items.watchOut: This is a spend-linked loyalty voucher, not a no-purchase freebie. It is valid for 31 days, is non-transferable and can only be used by the registered member under the current redemption rules.

items.title: Bootlegger app registration coffee
items.summary: Bootlegger's official loyalty-app guide states that new users receive a free coffee on registration.
items.bestFor: New Bootlegger Coffee Company app users near a participating cafe
requirements: Download the Bootlegger app, create a new account and redeem the registration reward under the current in-app conditions.
items.watchOut: Check the reward's product choice, validity period and participating cafe availability in the app before travelling. The separate stamp reward requires ten purchases.

items.title: Telkom R550 customer referral credit
items.summary: Telkom's current customer-referral terms offer the referrer R550 account credit after a successful referred order is put into service.
items.bestFor: Existing Telkom customers with an active fixed or mobile service who know someone considering a new Telkom fibre contract
requirements: The referrer must be an existing Telkom customer with an active fixed or mobile service. Referrals are limited to friends or family, up to 30 contacts per day, and the referred person must not already have an active Telkom fibre service.
items.watchOut: This is Telkom account credit, not cash, a prize draw or a public publisher-affiliate programme. The referred person takes out a paid fibre contract and may face early-termination penalties. Mo'Nice is a separate personalised prepaid promotion, not part of this referral reward.

items.title: SA Youth work and learning support
items.provider: SA Youth work and learning support
items.summary: Free access to the SA Youth network and work-readiness support. Harambee advertises zero-rated access to sayouth.mobi on participating South African networks.
items.bestFor: Young unemployed South Africans seeking work and learning opportunities
requirements: Register with SA Youth and check each opportunity’s eligibility. Existing Harambee users can use their existing login.
items.watchOut: External application websites may use data. Initial loading and background apps may consume data. Registration does not guarantee employment or a place on a programme.

items.title: McDonald's app free birthday ice-cream cone
items.summary: McDonald's South Africa app members who provide the correct date of birth receive a free ice-cream cone reward on their birthday for redemption at a participating restaurant.
requirements: McDonald's app membership required
McDonald's South Africa app registration required
Correct date of birth must be stored in the app profile
Redeem the in-app reward at a participating restaurant
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Spur kids' free birthday meal and ice cream
items.summary: Children aged zero to 12 linked to a parent or guardian's Spur Family profile receive a free Kids' Menu meal and Chico the Clown ice cream birthday voucher, valid for three months.
requirements: Child must be linked to a parent or guardian's free Spur Family profile
Child must be aged zero to 12
Child must be present for restaurant or Call & Collect redemption
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Mugg & Bean free birthday cake slice
items.summary: Qualifying Mugg & Bean Loyalty App members receive a birthday voucher for a cake slice at a Sit-Down restaurant or a bundt cake at On-The-Move. From 1 September 2026 it is issued on the actual birthday and is valid for 30 days. Two qualifying app uses in the preceding 12 months are required.
requirements: Mugg & Bean loyalty membership required
Mugg & Bean Loyalty App registration required
Use the app payment or receipt-scan feature at least twice in the preceding 12 months
Voucher must be used within its 30-day validity period
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Ocean Basket app birthday treat
items.summary: Ocean Basket app members may receive one complimentary birthday treat per year, redeemable for 30 days from their recorded birthday. The item varies by restaurant and availability; check your Rewards Wallet before visiting.
requirements: Ocean Basket app membership required
App membership is for people aged 18 or older
Register in the Ocean Basket app with a valid mobile number and email
Record your correct birthday; corrections require support
Confirm the item and conditions shown in your Rewards Wallet with the participating restaurant
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Starbucks Gold birthday drink
items.summary: Starbucks South Africa Gold members receive a birthday Free Drink Reward valid for 30 days. Gold requires 750 Stars earned within 12 months, so this is a benefit for qualifying loyalty customers, not a drink for every new signup.
requirements: Gold-level Starbucks Rewards membership required
Earn 750 Stars in 12 months through qualifying activity; another 750 Stars maintains Gold for the next year
Provide your birthday in your member profile and check the reward in your account
Redeem only at participating South African Starbucks stores
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: CapeNature free walk-in day access: 19–25 September
items.summary: Participating Western Cape reserves waive general conservation entry fees for permitted day activities during Access Week. Walk-in access only.
requirements: 19–25 September 2026 during normal reserve hours. No pre-booking for free entry; capacity limits apply. Online or Contact Centre bookings are charged. The waiver covers general conservation entry for permitted day activities, including hiking and mountain biking. Whale Trail, selected landowners, partners, concessions and commercial activities are excluded. Accommodation is not free. Check trail closures, opening hours and the official participating-reserve list.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Mugg & Bean new-app cappuccino after qualifying spend
items.summary: New Mugg & Bean app users who spend over R50 in their first month qualify for one complimentary Easy Cappuccino voucher.
requirements: App registration and spending over R50 in the first month are required. One Easy Cappuccino voucher is issued to qualifying new users; no loyalty is earned when redeeming it. The public clause does not specify its redemption expiry, so check the voucher in the app before visiting. This welcome reward is separate from the birthday cake benefit.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.
